events.title: Demo Hotfix Notice v0.1093.1.35
events.summary: Thank you for playing the demo. Based on your reports, we have taken steps to address the following issue: An error occurring when opening the save slot list on some systems. If you have encountered this issue, please update the game and try again. We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for helping us by reporting the issue. Thank you for your continued support of Life Is a Dungeon: Lean into It.
